sdk.auth_notes: DSH resolves credentials from its own settings, which name the environment variable holding the key. The ACP child inherits that environment; key material never appears in argv, prompt text, or a route overlay.
sdk.approval_notes: ACP carries no approval negotiation. Declare the workspace, provider, model, overlay path, and expected overlay digest as typed inputs. The pinned runner validates the exact acp-row overlay, snapshots its bytes, and records the computed digest. Before prompting, require the actual provider/model returned in session/new or session/resume configOptions to equal the request; report requested, configured, and observed values separately. Resume requires the exact session id, workspace, provider, model, and overlay digest recorded by this Process; never substitute the newest session or fall back to another route.

advisory_vocabulary.semantics: self-reported presence, never proof of completion; carries no control state and never blocks the lane
